Strategy: Widen the sweet band to residuals between twenty-eight and fifty while keeping the mid penalty, testing whether a broader pull toward reusable leftovers works better. This covers more residual sizes than the narrow band, but the wider bonus may reward many bins and blur into Best Fit.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 50 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
